prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet of SAME referenced corridor heavy: massive hunched gray beetle with layered mossy stone armor, ivory mask, ragged purple cape and cracked mossy brass bell hammer. Same dark ink hand-painted finish. STRICT 4 columns × 8 rows = 32 COMPLETE isolated full-body poses on portrait canvas. VERY SMALL sprites with LARGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT gutters, all hammers and antennae must fit inside each cell; keep hammer compact near body, no horizontally extended weapon outside cell. Facing RIGHT, equal body size and anchor. Row1 4 idle breathing poses. Row2 4 walk first-half poses. Row3 4 walk second-half poses. Row4 4 windup lifting hammer overhead. Row5 4 downward hammer slam strike/followthrough poses, compact vertical motion. Row6 4 recovery lifting hammer back to rest. Row7 4 hurt stagger/recoil poses. Row8 4 death collapse poses ending prone. Every pose genuine different joints and hammer angle; no duplicates. Exactly 4 figures each row, exactly 8 rows. Actual alpha transparency, no background, grid, text, labels, shadows or frame borders.

qa.layout: 4 columns by 8 rows, all 32 complete pose silhouettes reviewed
qa.identity: Mossy stone armored beetle with cracked bell hammer retained
qa.motion: Different articulated walking legs, overhead hammer windup, compact slam, hurt and collapse
qa.final_review: Packaged runtime atlas visually reviewed: complete isolated whole character poses, held weapons/props retained, transparent margins, no neighboring silhouette fragments.
qa.component_isolation: Explicit full silhouette seeds isolate interlocking rectangular bounds without modifying RGBA art.
qa.validation: tools/build_expanded_character_motion.py --character corridor_heavy passes unique-pose, alpha, full-component, crop-margin, schema and minimum-count checks.
qa.rig_origin: Fixed source-sheet column cell center, shared across poses independent of silhouette bounding width. Main grids use their actual4/6 columns; supplemental attack strip2 columns; original atlas4 columns. Resolution factor applies uniformly after rig anchoring; actual authored lunges retained.

combat_motion_v7.calibration: Continuous endpoint height and rig median; uniform sheet palette match; source pixels never morphed or interpolated.
